what: A narrow vertical window, 180×380 and vertically centered, standing across the section’s left edge (−180px) widens to the full screen width and height (top-left 0) from the second to the third screen of scroll (scrub 1, following the scroll 1s late). The photo inside returns from its −220px offset to 0 0, so the photo that peeked through a narrow gap opens up like a door. On the section before the horizontally pushed panel, the window’s edge shows first.

options.start · end: Expand range (ScrollTrigger style, element based), default ‹200% top›·‹400% bottom› — original: 2–3 screens of scroll while a screen-height section sits at the very top of the document
options.trigger: Reference element css (this element if empty)
options.--fx-left · --fx-w · --fx-h: Initial window left · width · height (via style), default −180px · 180px · 380px
options.--fx-shift: Initial image horizontal offset (via style), default −220px
options.[data-fx-part=img]: Image inside the window — moves object-position for an img, background-position for a background

from.where: index.html .ow-imgwrap (original #imgwrap .mask: left −180px · top 50%−190px · 180×380 → innerWidth×innerHeight, .img object-position −220px 0 → 0 0, trigger container 200% top → wrapper 400% bottom, scrub 1)
